name: secureguard
description: Security assessment and vulnerability prevention platform for web applications

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w security-lab && npm run test -w security-tests
